text: Assumption: The bit constants kTestFailed etc. correspond to the ISO 14229 UDS status byte semantics — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The bit constants kTestFailed etc. correspond to the ISO 14229 UDS status byte semantics — is this correct?
norm: the bit constants ktestfailed etc correspond to the iso 14229 uds status byte semantics
assumption: The bit constants kTestFailed etc. correspond to the ISO 14229 UDS status byte semantics.
rationale: The identifiers mirror UDS DTC status bits, but the definition of the bits themselves is not included as an enum in the payload.
